title: Build Grave Accord with 63 bosses, class transformations and roving Warden phases
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord implements 63 distinct boss identities, seven classes, 378 skills/63 paths, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes, with individual original boss themes. This remains unfinished feature-branch development; PR #14 stays draft and main protected.

The Warden quality pass gives fixed 2-- Lantern Warden two distinct phases. Still Watch stays planted; half-health Roving Vigil warns a route and moves the real boss against map collision at 72 px/s, up to 144 px, before the next sweep and during recovery. The ground origin and aim lock for the complete 1.2-second warning and four-second dangerous sweep. Normal health/damage/deadline and the original sweep geometry remain unchanged.

Brutal alternates sweep direction. Its final phase replaces overlapping cones with a sequential reverse return after a brief pause and a new full warning; only one cone can be dangerous at a time. Recovery fans emit two warned locked-origin waves through the bounded echo queue. At sweep release, auxiliary hazards clear, preserving the marked trailing safe space. Four original patrol poses, route/direction cues, persistent phase responses and fifteen-locale help connect to shared authority/offline/online state. Last Light remains the original 72-BPM Warden theme with tempo-aligned phase/Brutal percussion.

The exact built-in ImageGen native/request and portable bindings are committed. The first equal-cell packing assumption crossed the third-pose lantern; selected ownership regions preserve the whole lantern and complete source RGBA. One scale plus compensated world display preserves the established 150-pixel body. Earlier Warden source/contract/atlas bytes remain unchanged. Total selected motion poses rise to 1,506. The independent verifier reconstructs native/atlas pixels, anchors and all preserved hashes.

All prior human difficulty requests remain: combat revival Baby100%, Easy50%, Normal25%, Hard+disabled through every source; Baby/Easy Standard shield events only, six/three circles and two/three-second channels; every Brutal removes that event. Baby adds two cover props/map; Hard half cover, Insane/Hellish none. Hellish has warned lava and forces every encounter Brutal. Entry threats retain two half-health phases with divided health and independent transition cues. Normal health is unchanged.

Twenty-one purchased class transformations, three per class, remain integrated at existing utility-path depth-three nodes for six cumulative SP. IDs, costs, prerequisites, numeric bonuses and one-capstone limit stay intact; both classic/expanded shops have fifteen-locale help. The optional default-off all-54-skill map, profiles/mastery/cosmetics/remaps, all five modes and bank-safe secret consent are already implemented. Early Watch adds three original encounters with 36 motion poses, distinct mechanics, individual scores and complete locale help.

Protocol19 migrates known issued protocol18 local Practice saves/profiles, preserving purchases, run identity and progress; online/signed state stays strict. All earlier bounded migrations remain.

Validation:469 automated tests plus authored content/fifteen locales, TypeScript and production build pass. Twelve new tests cover all six maps and five cover rules, patrol/body collision and speed, fixed origins/aim, actual full sequential warnings, real repeated projectiles, live trailing-safe damage, reduced-motion pose selection, cleanup, local migration, protocol rejection, independent RGBA reconstruction and actual two-client replication. CI installs the pinned image-verification dependency in an isolated Python environment. Exact source/artifact hashes and failed attempts are retained under reviews/warden-patrol-2026-10-25/.

The roster remains62 ordinary plus1 secret;88 more ordinary identities remain. Two original-roster quality passes are implemented and58 remain, with zero human acceptances. All seven class-upgrade implementation passes and optional skill-map implementation are complete. Boss/special-ability art, rendered animation, native-language/listening/human balance/physical devices, active mixed-progression/WAN/full endurance, hosted recovery/rankings and coordinated release gates remain open. Simultaneous boss pairs remain future encounter work.

Canonical Wiki:18 pages/30 images, published and hash-verified separately from source pushes. Every frozen preview is preserved. The public protocol4 Site and immutable protocol13 Windows development archive remain separate. No deployment, main merge, paid provisioning or contest submission is included.
